subject.title: Feature: per-channel announce suppression for sub-agents

question: Which public completion-delivery primitive should OpenClaw expose for sub-agent announcements: per-channel suppression, global/per-spawn policy, parent/internal target, plugin hook, or a unified audience policy?
rationale: The missing behavior is clear in source, but the fix adds public config/tool surface and overlaps related global suppression, parent routing, hook, and fallback reliability semantics that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Unify Completion Delivery Policy
options.body: Add one additive policy that can express per-channel suppression and internal-only completion delivery while covering all delivery and fallback branches.

options.title: Narrow Per-Channel Suppression
options.body: Add only a channel-level suppression key and leave parent routing and hook use cases tracked separately.

options.title: Defer To Broader Hook Or Audience Work
options.body: Keep the issue open until maintainers choose a broader event-audience or post-completion hook API that can subsume channel suppression.

recommendation.title: Unify Completion Delivery Policy
recommendation.body: Add one additive policy that can express per-channel suppression and internal-only completion delivery while covering all delivery and fallback branches.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest feature-history signal for the spawn/announce public API and already gave maintainer-facing context on this issue.
